notes:
Research: Means-Ends Analysis comes from Newell, Shaw and Simon's General Problem Solver (1959) and Simon & Newell's Human Problem Solving (1972). Core loop: compare current state to goal state, detect the most significant difference, select an operator known to reduce that difference, test the operator's preconditions; if a precondition is unmet, promote it to a sub-goal and recurse. Slots kept from the registry: current_state, goal_state, difference, operator, precondition, subgoal. The two states are usually stated; the difference that matters most, the precondition an operator needs, and the promotion of an unmet precondition to a sub-goal are the framework's own contribution and are derived. Recursion is the point: a sub-goal is a goal, so the structure nests. idea field lives on precondition and subgoal nodes (an unmet precondition nobody owns is often a business). Classic misuse: hill-climbing on the nearest difference and ignoring a large difference that needs a detour (the Tower of Hanoi / Missionaries-and-Cannibals trap where the correct move temporarily increases the distance).

Scout returned three candidates: (1) Hadrian / Chris Power, 2025-07-17, Factory 3 build-out; (2) Radiant / Doug Bernauer, 2025-12-17, first reactor to mass production; (3) Valar Atomics / Isaiah Taylor, 2025-11-11. Chose (1): it is the only one where the speaker states the unmet precondition out loud AND says money cannot satisfy it ('you could give me a billion dollars and say, go hire 2,000 welders'), which is the exact moment a precondition is promoted to a sub-goal. The two nuclear candidates have richer precondition chains but their states are less numerically paired, and both sit in a crowded nuclear-capacity theme.

Graph decisions: three of the five difference nodes are facts, not derived as the registry's typical_provenance suggests, because Power actually states them ('And so obviously need more capacity', 'coming to us for the schedule and the capacity and stability versus cost', 'we can no longer have that scaled workforce in the country'). Marking them derived would have been dishonest. The two derived differences are the ones nobody states: df2 (4x of floor against 20x of demand, the quotient neither speaker takes) and df5 (the thirty-year software lag read as the gap blocking the 10x-productivity operator). All preconditions and all sub-goals are derived, which is the framework's real contribution here. idea_bearing_slot is precondition; ideas sit on pc2 (0.90) and pc3 (0.70), plus one on sg3 (0.70) in the subgoal slot, which the validator permits. Two fact nodes (op3, the $260M round, and cs5, the software lag) have no fact edge, so they stand alone in the facts-only view; that is true to the source, where the round is announced without a stated link to what it buys and the software lag is offered as a recruiting pitch in a different passage. validate.mjs: 0 errors, 0 warnings on the first run.
